summary: This study looks at how a drug called semaglutide oral tablet affects blood vessels in people with type 2 diabetes and atherosclerosis, a condition where plaque builds up in the arteries. The research aims to learn more about how this treatment protects the heart and blood vessels. A total of 100 participants are taking part in the study. University Medical Centre Ljubljana is the sponsor for this trial, which has an unknown status and no phase listed.
